blocks.text: The Sass math module has tools for calculations. math.div divides values while Sass builds the stylesheet.
Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.
Read the code step by step

items: `@use` loads a Sass module once. A module prefix keeps its variables and functions distinct from local names.
`math.div` performs Sass division during the build. It is clearer than using a slash that CSS may interpret differently.

blocks.text: The card gets 12px of padding. Sass does the division before the browser loads the page.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use math.div for Sass division. A slash can have another meaning in CSS values.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change space to 32px and work out the new padding.
